news.title: Anfield, intensity, rotation - how Iraola is improving Liverpool
news.description: Liverpool fans are finding joy at Anfield again with a feel-good factor around the club before the visit of reigning champions Arsenal on Sunday.

news.title: Are Manchester United really at risk of a relegation scrap?
news.description: Manchester United's current tally of seven points from nine games would not even get them 30 points if it was continued for the full season.

news.title: Are De Zerbi's Spurs finding elusive consistency?
news.description: Are Spurs finally finding elusive consistency under Roberto de Zerbi after a third successive Premier League win, asks chief football writer Phil McNulty?

news.title: Maresca's big test is to address mounting Man City issues
news.description: Enzo Maresca enjoyed a flawless start as Manchester City manager, winning his first seven Premier League games in charge, but the honeymoon period is now over.

news.title: Third choice? Inside Alexander-Arnold's struggles in Madrid
news.description: Trent Alexander-Arnold is currently third-choice right-back at Real Madrid - where does his future lie?

news.title: Chelsea beat 10-man Man Utd to pile more pressure on Carrick
news.description: Lisandro Martinez is sent off for Manchester United as they suffer a 2-0 defeat against Chelsea at Stamford Bridge to pile more pressure on under-fire manager Michael Carrick.

news.title: Brighton pick up first away league victory over Man City
news.description: Brighton pick up their first away league victory at Manchester City, winning 1-0 to condemn City to a second successive Premier League defeat.

news.title: Coventry out of bottom three with win over struggling Sunderland
news.description: Frank Lampard's Coventry City lift themselves out of the relegation zone after beating struggling Sunderland, who remain rooted to the bottom of the Premier League table.

news.title: Enciso's stunning goal earns Ipswich draw at Hull
news.description: Julio Enciso scores the equalising goal for Ipswich as they draw 2-2 with Hull at the  MKM Stadium.

news.title: Spurs revival continues with victory over 10-man Crystal Palace
news.description: Jean-Philippe Mateta was shown an early red card as Crystal Palace lose 2-0 at Tottenham to increase the pressure on manager Pierre Sage.
